_about: Seed knowledge bites for the operator's profile vector DB (M6 bootstrap). Topic namespaces are web-sourced and cited (location = URL); the operator-profile namespace is from the user's own context reference. Re-embed + load with: python scripts/seed_profile.py

bites.author: Wikipedia
bites.text: Young Franco (Joseph Da Rin de Barbera, b. 1994) is an Australian DJ and record producer from Brisbane, based in Sydney.

bites.author: UnnamedProject
bites.text: His sound intertwines hip hop, electronic, funk and nu-disco into smooth, lively, dancefloor-oriented cuts.

bites.author: Vice
bites.text: He is recognized as a rising Australian future-funk producer, blending funk, soul, house and disco with a millennial edge.

bites.author: Seismic Talent Agency
bites.text: He holds four ARIA-Gold-certified singles, an Emmy nomination, over 200 million streams, and more than a million monthly Spotify listeners.

bites.author: Rolling Stone Australia
bites.text: His January 2025 debut LP 'Of Leisure' blends disco, italo-disco, rap, punk and dance music.

bites.source_title: The Art of War, applied to business
bites.author: Startups.com
bites.text: 'Know your enemy and know yourself': deeply understanding both competitors and your own business is what lets you make decisions that minimize risk and maximize opportunity.

bites.source_title: Use The Art of War in Your Business
bites.author: Asymmetric
bites.text: As a startup, avoid attacking competitors at their strongest point; strike where they least expect, after analyzing the competition before launch.

bites.source_title: Sun Tzu for Small Business Leaders
bites.author: Asymmetric
bites.text: Strategic positioning means finding niche, underserved segments suited to your strengths rather than competing head-on.

bites.source_title: Sun Tzu in Modern Strategic Planning
bites.author: Asymmetric
bites.text: Sustainable competitive advantage comes from rapid adaptation: firms that thrive run frequent, cheap experiments on offerings, models and processes.

bites.source_title: Sun Tzu in Modern Strategic Planning
bites.author: Asymmetric
bites.text: 'Heaven' is the broader market environment — economic, technological, regulatory and cultural conditions — which strategy must continuously monitor and adapt to.

bites.author: Tony Kharioki
bites.text: To 'shape' or change the rules of the game, a startup builds alliances and useful networks.

bites.author: Steph Ango
bites.text: File over app: if you want to create digital artifacts that last, they must be files you can control, in formats that are easy to retrieve and read.

bites.author: Steph Ango
bites.text: All software is ephemeral; tool makers should accept this and give people ownership over their data.

bites.author: Steph Ango
bites.text: In the fullness of time, the files you create are more important than the tools you use to create them.

bites.author: Steph Ango
bites.text: Open, accessible formats like Markdown, HTML and plain text have long-term value and will likely outlive proprietary software.

bites.author: Steph Ango
bites.text: If notes live in files, you can move, read, script, back up and hand them to tools without asking an app for permission.

bites.author: Wikipedia
bites.text: The Center for Humane Technology (founded 2018 by Tristan Harris, Aza Raskin and Randima Fernando) works to mitigate the harms of attention-maximizing business models.

bites.author: Wikipedia
bites.text: Time Well Spent (Tristan Harris, 2013) argued that sites should avoid design methods that exploit deficiencies in user attention spans.

bites.author: Wikipedia
bites.text: Persuasive-design techniques exploit psychology for prolonged engagement: intermittent variable rewards, fear of missing out, desire for social approval, reciprocity pressure and interrupting notifications.

bites.author: Center for Humane Technology
bites.text: Humane design asks that a product have an end goal other than maximizing usage to sell advertising, respecting users' time.

bites.author: Al Jazeera
bites.text: The humane-tech movement rebels against the attention economy and helped inspire Digital Well-Being tools such as Apple Screen Time and Google Digital Wellbeing.

bites.author: (operator)
bites.text: The operator is a researcher-builder whose throughline is research-into-artifact: investigate a domain thoroughly, then build something tangible from it.

bites.author: (operator)
bites.text: He values systems that are inspectable and traceable over black boxes, and evidence over assertion; he is skeptical of unanchored claims.

bites.author: (operator)
bites.text: Design system 'Manifest V2': DM Serif Display for titles, Poppins for body, Space Mono for data; achromatic surfaces with accent color used only in text and borders; 8px radius; 52px sticky nav.

bites.author: (operator)
bites.text: Ideation lens: prefer ideas that are AI-native, built on contextual trust, that empower live shared experiences, favor collaboration over performance, and are anti-exploitation.

bites.author: (operator)
bites.text: Idea sanity check: would this still be good for the user if it earned the company nothing from engagement?

bites.author: (operator)
bites.text: Aesthetic north star in music is Young Franco (nu-disco / future-funk / house); strategic frame is Sun Tzu's Art of War applied to business and startups.
